fields.number: Hymn number in that edition (blank for a removed record)
fields.section: Section of the book on the Church pages (1985 and Hymns—For Home and Church)
fields.title: Title as printed (the 1835 and 1841 books have none; they are known by first line)
fields.firstLine: First line as printed (as transcribed by the Joseph Smith Papers for 1835 and 1841)
fields.text: Text credit as printed, life dates or year included (copyright notices left out)
fields.yearWritten: Year in the text credit when the book gives one (Hymns—For Home and Church does; 1985 gives life dates instead)
fields.authorDenomination: Authors' religion from Wikidata, only when the Wikidata person matches name and life dates; blank when unknown
fields.hymnKey: Links the same text across editions (normalized first six words of the first line, or a hand link)
fields.change: added | kept | removed, against the previous edition in this dataset; blank for 1985, whose predecessor is not in the dataset yet
fields.previousNumber: Number in the previous edition (kept and removed records)

gaps: Editions between 1841 and 1985 (the Manchester/Liverpool Sacred Hymns and Spiritual Songs line, Latter-day Saint Hymns 1927, Hymns 1948 and 1950) are not in yet, so 1985 has no change status.
Hymns—For Home and Church is still being released; it has only the hymns published so far and no removed records.
The 1835 and 1841 books print no author credits.
Wording changes between editions are not tracked yet.
